page.overview:
What is Drosera Plumbicare?

Drosera Plumbicare, sometimes simply known as D. Plumbicare and also known as Species 37, was an alien life form aboard the Weyland-Yutani Corporation exploratory vessel as of 2120, having been collected during a 65–year mission. It was freed from containment when the Maginot crashed into Prodigy City in New Siam on Earth.

D. Plumbicare appeared as a large, bulbous pod with roots on its base. The pod consisted of leaves which could open up and extend to engulf a prey and extendable tentacle/tongue-like stamen to sense prey. Said stamen could not only gauge atmospheric pressure and temperature of its surroundings, but also to sense potential prey and discern whether they were edible; the specimen captured by Maginot crew cautiously aimed its stamen at Tootles but otherwise not attacked him because of his Hybrid nature, a contrast to its encounter with Siberian whom it devoured outright. If its surroundings became inhospitable or worse, the threat to its survival was nearby, D. Plumbicare would close completely. The stem of D. Plumbicare could also be stretched in a quick motion to increase its attack range.

D. Plumbicare secreted mucilage to lure in unsuspecting prey.

Upon being engulfed by its leaves, the prey would be killed in one of three ways; through asphyxiation, by being dissolved, or through sheer exhaustion trying to escape. Regardless, D. Plumbicare would excrete digestive enzyme once the prey no longer moved. The leaves of D. Plumbicare also possessed deceptively great brute force as it couldn't be opened even with many kilograms of pressure.
